tasks.title: Verification sweep
tasks.description:
Final audit. Run `grep -rni ralph` across the repo, excluding .git/, node_modules/, dist/, .venv/, and the historical-record files.

Every surviving hit must fall into exactly one of two categories:
1. An INTENTIONAL compatibility fallback — dual-read discovery (.ralph/), config fallback (ralph.json), temp-file prefix fallback (.ralph_*), the RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET env chains, and the ralph symlink in install.sh.
2. A HISTORICAL RECORD file that must never be rewritten: .ralph/tasks.completed.json, .ralph/.ralph_iterations.log, .ralph/.ralph_tasks_snapshot.json, .ralph/reviews/round-*.md, .ralph_task_*_notes.md, audit/ contents, and .ralph/planning-notes.md.

Anything else is a miss from an earlier task — fix it.

Mark every fallback in category 1 with a comment: `// remove once all projects migrated` (or the language-appropriate equivalent). Six projects share this tool and five still use the .ralph/ layout; the removal round happens only after all are migrated, and these markers make it mechanical.

Report the final tally: how many references remain, and the category breakdown. bun test must pass.
tasks.notes:
# Task #46 — Verification sweep

## Final tally

`grep -rni ralph` (excluding `.git/`, `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.venv/`) → **987 matching lines**.
Every one is now accounted for:

| Bucket | Lines | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **Historical record** (never rewritten) | **516** | `.ralph/tasks.completed.json` (310), `.ralph/reviews/round-4.md` (143), `.ralph/planning-notes.md` (63) |
| **Test suite** exercising the fallbacks | **345** | fixtures that build `.ralph/`-layout projects, `ralph.json` configs, `RALPH_*` env, `.ralph_`-prefixed temp files; plus rename-regression guards (`expect(output).not.toContain('ralph init')`) and `install-script.test.ts` asserting the `ralph` symlink still exists |
| **Docs** describing the compatibility window | **47** | `CLAUDE.md` (25), `README.md` (19), `docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md` (3) |
| **Category 1 — intentional fallbacks, marked** | **54** | `src/` (37), `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` (6), `install.sh` (4), `.ralph/.gitignore` (7) |
| **This repo's own un-migrated layout** | **8** | `ralph.json` (3 — `projectName`/`projectDescription`/`ntfyTopic`), `.ralph/tasks.json` (5 — CLI-managed task text) |
| **Socket/pid literals — NOT a fallback, owned by #48** | **7** | `src/narration.ts`, `src/commands/narrate.ts` (×2), `src/commands/run.ts`, `.claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh` |
| *(excluded — globally git-ignored, untracked)* | *10* | `.claude/settings.local.json` |

`516 + 345 + 47 + 54 + 8 + 7 + 10 = 987`. ✓

**31** `remove once all projects migrated` markers across `src/`, `lib/`, `install.sh`.
**3** `TODO(#48)` markers on the socket/pid literals.

## Misses found and fixed

1. **`.claude/agents/*.md` + `.claude/commands/*.md` were stale.** The canonical templates at
   `agents/` and `commands/` (fixed by task #42) were already clean, but this repo's own installed
   copies under `.claude/` still said "Ralph agentic loop system" and `.ralph/tasks.json`.
   Refreshed by copying the templates over them — exactly what `cairn init` / `cairn migrate` do.
   **17 lines.**
2. **`bun.lock` recorded the workspace as `"name": "ralph"`** while `package.json` says `"cairn"`.
   `bun install` would not rewrite it (no dependency change ⇒ no lockfile write), so the one string
   was edited directly; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` then verifies clean.
3. **`src/utils.ts` had two dead provenance pointers** — "Port of resolve_path() from bin/ralph
   lines 7-16" and the same for `find_project_root()`. `bin/ralph` has not existed since the TS
   rewrite, so the line numbers pointed at nothing. Replaced with "the original shell implementation".
4. **`src/utils.ts:192`** said the compiled binary "could be at `dist/ralph` or `bin/ralph`" — the
   build output is `dist/cairn`. Fixed. Guarded by a new test asserting no `dist/ralph` in source.
5. **~150 cosmetic leftovers in `test/`** — `mkdtemp` prefixes (`ralph-test-`, `ralph-narr-test-`, …),
   the local `ralphDir` / `fakeRalphRoot` / `withRalphDir` identifiers, argv `['node', 'ralph', …]`,
   test titles ("copies .md files from ralph commands/"), `commitPrefix: 'ralph'`, and
   `CAIRN_LIB_DIR = '/usr/lib/ralph'`. All renamed to `cairn-`. **Deliberately left alone:** every
   `.ralph/` / `ralph.json` / `RALPH_*` fixture (they *are* the legacy-layout coverage), the two
   `not.toContain('ralph init'|'ralph plan')` regression guards, `migrate.test.ts`'s
   `ralph.json -> cairn.json` output assertion, and all of `install-script.test.ts`.

## Markers added (category 1)

`remove once all projects migrated`, one per fallback site, each saying what collapses when it goes:

- `src/brand.ts` — the `LEGACY` object (the entry point for the removal round)
- `src/utils.ts` — `dataDirNameAt`, `warnIfLegacyDataDir`, `findDataDir`, the runtime-temp-file
  section header, `allTempFilePaths`, `findTempFilePath`, `findProjectRoot`'s upward walk
- `src/config.ts` — `findConfigFile`, `loadConfig`, `resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain`, `warnIfLegacyApiKey`
- `src/index.ts`, `src/commands/edit.ts` — the resolve-never-reconstruct caveats
- `src/task-selector.ts`, `src/task-archiver.ts` (×2), `src/tasks-file.ts` — dual-read temp files
- `src/commands/run.ts` — `NOTES_TEMPFILE_RE`, the completion-flag check, the notes sweep
- `src/commands/migrate.ts` — the whole command
- `src/commands/init.ts` — `getConfigDefaults`, and `GITIGNORE_LEGACY_HEADER` (the generated
  data-dir `.gitignore` now carries the marker in its own text, so every project gets it)
- `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` — `RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET` and `RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` chains
- `install.sh` — the `~/.local/bin/ralph` symlink

## New test: `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` (3 tests)

Written first, failed, then made to pass — it caught two markers I had placed badly (one 4 lines
below its hit, one wrapped mid-phrase across two comment lines, so neither would have been found by
the grep the marker exists to serve).

Scans `src/**/*.ts`, `lib/*.py`, `agents/*.md`, `commands/*.md`, `install.sh`. Any line mentioning
the old name must have the marker within 20 lines above / 3 below. **The marker must sit on one
line** — a wrapped comment does not match. Exempts `/tmp/ralph-tts.{sock,pid}`, which must instead
carry `TODO(#48)`. Also asserts no `dist/ralph` path survives in source.

Not scanned: `test/` (fixtures legitimately build legacy-layout projects), `.claude/` (generated
per-project artifacts), docs (prose explains the window at length), data dirs.

## Deliberately NOT changed

- **`ralph.json` → `cairn.json` for this repo.** This project is still on the legacy layout itself.
  Migrating it means `cairn migrate`, which refuses while a task is `in-progress` — and moving
  `.ralph/` out from under a running `ralph run` loop mid-round would strand it. This is the last
  round task; migrate this repo manually once the loop is done. Note `healthCheck` is still pinned
  to the throwaway outfile `/tmp/cairn-healthcheck` per CLAUDE.md's pin/unpin procedure — restore it
  and re-run `./install.sh` when the round closes.
- **The five `/tmp/ralph-tts.{sock,pid}` literals.** Task #48's scope. Marked `TODO(#48)`.
- **`.claude/hooks/*.sh`** in this repo (they say `ralph-tts` and so currently *match* `run.ts`;
  regenerating them would point them at a socket nothing listens on).
- **`.claude/settings.local.json`** — globally git-ignored, untracked, machine-local.

## Live bug found (noted on #48, not fixed here)

`writeNarrationHooks` (`src/commands/init.ts`) already writes `/tmp/cairn-tts.sock` into generated
hooks — asserted by `test/commands/init.test.ts:1004` and `test/commands/migrate.test.ts:393` —
while `run.ts` still *starts* the server on `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock`. Generated hooks and the running
server therefore point at different sockets, so narration hooks are silent no-ops on any freshly
`cairn init`-ed project. #48 was filed as dead-constant cleanup; it is actually a real break.
Recorded via `ralph task note 48`. Also flagged there that #48's `files[]` still lists
`lib/ralph_narrate_server.py`, which is now `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py`.

## Docs

Added a **"The removal marker"** subsection to CLAUDE.md under "The compatibility window": the exact
marker string, the grep that produces the removal work list, what
`test/legacy-markers.test.ts` enforces, the single-line requirement, and the `TODO(#48)` exemption
plus the hook/server socket mismatch.

## Verification

- `bun test` → **844 pass, 0 fail**, 31 files (841 before; +3 from `legacy-markers.test.ts`).
- `bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-healthcheck` → clean, 0.44 MB.
- `bun install --frozen-lockfile` → clean, lockfile consistent with `package.json`.
- The build-health failure reported at the start of this iteration (`Browser build cannot import
  Node.js builtin: "readline"`) does **not** reproduce — that error is a `bun build` invocation
  missing `--target=bun`, and `ralph.json`'s `healthCheck` has the flag. Ran it verbatim, exit 0.
  Likely a stale/pinned binary invoking an older command; no source change was needed.

tasks.title: Wire BRAND.socket into the narration socket path
tasks.description: src/brand.ts defines BRAND.socket = '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' (tested in test/brand.test.ts) but it is dead — never imported or read anywhere. The actual narration socket path is still the literal '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock', hardcoded independently in src/narration.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), src/commands/run.ts (narrationSocketPath), src/commands/narrate.ts (DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH), lib/ralph_narrate_server.py (DEFAULT_SOCKET), and .claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh (SOCKET=). Unlike dataDir/configFile/tempPrefix, this identifier was never given the dual-name (current-preferred, legacy-fallback) treatment established in CLAUDE.md's 'Branding and the legacy layout' section, so it doesn't participate in the .cairn/.ralph rename at all. Decide whether to (a) apply the same current-preferred/legacy-fallback pattern to the socket path (probe both '/tmp/cairn-tts.sock' and '/tmp/ralph-tts.sock' at connect/health-check time, like findDataDir does for directories), or (b) remove the unused BRAND.socket constant and its test if socket-path branding is intentionally out of scope. Note the hook shell scripts (.claude/hooks/*.sh) are per-project generated files (written by `ralph init`), so any fix needs to flow through whatever generates them, not just the TS/Python readers.
tasks.notes: Task #40 scope note: /tmp/ralph-tts.pid (DEFAULT_PID_FILE, src/commands/narrate.ts:11) is NOT listed in this task's description but must move together with the socket path — it lives in the same /tmp namespace and a half-migrated pair (cairn socket + ralph pid) would orphan a running server's PID file. Whatever strategy is chosen (dual-probe vs remove BRAND.socket), apply it to the pid file too. Left untouched by #40 for that reason. | Live mismatch confirmed during task #46's sweep: writeNarrationHooks (src/commands/init.ts) already emits /tmp/cairn-tts.sock (asserted by test/commands/init.test.ts:1004 and test/commands/migrate.test.ts:393), while run.ts/narrate.ts/narration.ts still START the server on /tmp/ralph-tts.sock. So generated hooks and the running server point at DIFFERENT sockets today — narration hooks are silently no-ops on any freshly-inited project. This is not just dead-constant cleanup; it is a real break. Also note lib/ralph_narrate_server.py in this task's files[] is now lib/cairn_narrate_server.py. Task #46 left all five socket/pid literals in place and marked them TODO(#48); test/legacy-markers.test.ts exempts /tmp/ralph-tts.{sock,pid} from the 'remove once all projects migrated' marker rule on the strength of that TODO, so update that exemption when this lands.
